title: Fastpatch: stabilize host-side connection collapse during tenant-triggered retry storms
creator: Noah Chen
description: Summary: A subset of tenant traffic triggered a retry amplification cascade that exhausted host-facing connection pools and backend inflight queues, producing elevated 5xx rates (502/504) and long tail timeouts for hosted API customers. This ticket scopes an urgent fastpatch to stabilize admission, reduce amplification, and provide a controlled fallback path for impacted tenants while we implement longer-term mitigations.
comments: 2026-03-08 Noah Chen: Incident opened after SRE alert reported 8x increase in 502s from hosted-edge. Initial traces show repeated client retries correlating with tenant bursts and per-request synchronous backend fanout.

2026-03-09 Priya Nair: Triage - root cause hypothesis: retry amplification + connection pool exhaustion + synchronous kv/cache compaction during bursts. Reproduction with internal load generator succeeded. Prioritized P0 because paid customers experienced failed requests.

2026-03-10 Priya Nair: Implemented emergency admission gate in ingress proxy (config toggle) to soft-reject >50 rps from same tenant with 429 and guidance header. Deployed to canary (us-west-2) for 2 hours; 5xx rate on canary reduced ~65%.

2026-03-11 Dave Murphy (SRE): Observability added: per-tenant inflight counters, connection pool usage, and retry-origin fingerprint. Dashboards linked. Noted some tenants triggering burst patterns due to client SDK misconfiguration.

2026-03-12 Priya Nair: Code PR #1324: add per-tenant leaky-bucket admission and idempotency token validation in frontdoor. Tests added for edge cases where idempotency collisions could be false-positive. Requested review from Jared Collins and Lina Ortega.
2026-03-13 Jared Collins: Code review comments - tighten time window for admission token TTL, add metric for admitted vs rejected requests, ensure transparent diagnostic headers for customer bridges.

2026-03-14 Priya Nair: Deployed fastpatch globally with staged rollout and kill-switch. Post-deploy: aggregate 5xx drop of 72%, p95 latency improvement 28% for impacted tenants. Customers notified with initial post-incident note. Preparing longer-term tasks.

2026-03-15 Ava Martinez (PM): Request to coordinate Dedicated routing validation -- some Dedicated customers saw sporadic timeouts when routed through fallback. Added follow-up task to validate Dedicated admission integration.
2026-03-15 Priya Nair: Marking In Progress -> still monitoring. Next steps: backlog follow-ups, canary rollout for long-term shaper, update SDK guidance, and runbook edits.
acceptance_criteria: Global 5xx rate attributable to retry storms reduced to baseline + <10% within 24h of rollout
Per-tenant inflight and connection pool exhaustion events no longer correlated with customer-visible timeouts
Canary and production metrics for rejected vs admitted requests show expected leaky-bucket shaping behavior and no false-positive rejections >0.1%
Runbook updated with step-by-step mitigation: admission toggle, kill-switch, targeted tenant soft-eviction, and customer communication templates
Postmortem with RCA published and Dedicated routing validation task created
next_steps: Complete code review and merge PR #1324
Run canary for 48h with additional load patterns including long-lived streaming and large-multipart requests
Coordinate with Dedicated on-call to validate fallback routing behavior (ENG-xxxxxx follow-up)
Ship SDK guidance patch to reduce optimistic client retries and add exponential backoff defaults
Schedule incident postmortem and customer-facing detailed communication
